name: Progress Meter
description: Accessible horizontal progress bar built on the native <progress> element. Use as a report column (partial) or as a list of labelled bars (report).
helpText: Shows a value against a maximum. Map Value to a numeric column; non-numeric values render an empty bar instead of breaking the page. State colors the bar with the theme palette.

attributes.name: Label
attributes.helpText: Visible caption above the bar. Also used as the accessible name of the progress bar.

attributes.name: Value
attributes.helpText: Current numeric value, for example 42. Use a plain number with a period as decimal separator.

attributes.name: Maximum
attributes.helpText: Value that represents a full bar. Defaults to 100.

attributes.name: Value Text
attributes.helpText: Formatted value shown next to the label, for example 42% or 8 of 12 tasks. Leave empty to hide.

attributes.name: State
attributes.helpText: Optional per-row state: success, warning, danger or info. Anything else uses the primary color.
